final_answer:
Five high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I treated a requirement as high-risk when its FRA row (ASSESSES link) has risk_class = HIGH. That gives 26 requirements. I then walked the verification path, checked the latest execution on each unit, and compared it with the implementation dates of any change control that modifies the requirement, a child spec or the unit.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell is rejected for GMP runs) | No test case verifies it. Its configuration spec, CS-EBR-03, has no test case either. The other EBR requirements are covered by TC-OQ-EBR-01 to 05, but nothing covers this one. |
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its latest execution on INC-03 is TX-0023, a FAIL (alarm at 142 s, DEV-26-011). INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed, but every unit needs a passing latest execution. The OQ report was approved with this exception, and no re-test is recorded. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (SMS and voice escalation within 15 min) | The verification is stale. CC-26-011 changed CS-EMS-03, which satisfies this requirement, and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The only verifying test, TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20, before the change, and was not re-run. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | This is a PERFORMANCE requirement on an equipment system, so PQ evidence is expected. The only verifying test is TC-OQ-CRF-01, run on an empty chamber. There is no PQ protocol or test for SYS-CRF. |
| **URS-PRDG-002** (locked, version-controlled enrichment program delivering ≥90% CD3+ purity) | This is also a PERFORMANCE requirement on an equipment system. It is verified only by the OQ test TC-OQ-PRDG-02, which checks program lock and version. The Prodigy PQ, TC-PQ-PRDG-01, covers only the closed-processing requirement URS-PRDG-001. |

URS-PRDG-002 is the most debatable call. It rests on the PQ-expected rule for PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment, not on a failed or stale test.

Some things I checked that do not change the result:
- **URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002:** CC-26-014 (compressor replacement on FRZ-80-02, implemented 2026-04-23) would have made them stale. TC-OQ-ULT-01 and TC-OQ-ULT-02 were re-run and passed on 2026-04-24, so they count as verified.
- **INC-03 door switch:** CC-26-019 is approved but not implemented, so it has no effect yet.
- **MOI change:** CC-26-022, the proposed MOI increase to 8.0, is still at impact assessment and modifies only an SOP. I ignored it.

```json
{"answer_ids": ["URS-EBR-009", "URS-INC-004", "URS-EMS-014", "URS-CRF-001", "URS-PRDG-002"]}
```

content.text:
Five high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I treated a requirement as high-risk when its FRA row (ASSESSES link) has risk_class = HIGH. That gives 26 requirements. I then walked the verification path, checked the latest execution on each unit, and compared it with the implementation dates of any change control that modifies the requirement, a child spec or the unit.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell is rejected for GMP runs) | No test case verifies it. Its configuration spec, CS-EBR-03, has no test case either. The other EBR requirements are covered by TC-OQ-EBR-01 to 05, but nothing covers this one. |
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its latest execution on INC-03 is TX-0023, a FAIL (alarm at 142 s, DEV-26-011). INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed, but every unit needs a passing latest execution. The OQ report was approved with this exception, and no re-test is recorded. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (SMS and voice escalation within 15 min) | The verification is stale. CC-26-011 changed CS-EMS-03, which satisfies this requirement, and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The only verifying test, TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20, before the change, and was not re-run. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | This is a PERFORMANCE requirement on an equipment system, so PQ evidence is expected. The only verifying test is TC-OQ-CRF-01, run on an empty chamber. There is no PQ protocol or test for SYS-CRF. |
| **URS-PRDG-002** (locked, version-controlled enrichment program delivering ≥90% CD3+ purity) | This is also a PERFORMANCE requirement on an equipment system. It is verified only by the OQ test TC-OQ-PRDG-02, which checks program lock and version. The Prodigy PQ, TC-PQ-PRDG-01, covers only the closed-processing requirement URS-PRDG-001. |

URS-PRDG-002 is the most debatable call. It rests on the PQ-expected rule for PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment, not on a failed or stale test.

Some things I checked that do not change the result:
- **URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002:** CC-26-014 (compressor replacement on FRZ-80-02, implemented 2026-04-23) would have made them stale. TC-OQ-ULT-01 and TC-OQ-ULT-02 were re-run and passed on 2026-04-24, so they count as verified.
- **INC-03 door switch:** CC-26-019 is approved but not implemented, so it has no effect yet.
- **MOI change:** CC-26-022, the proposed MOI increase to 8.0, is still at impact assessment and modifies only an SOP. I ignored it.
